newsitem.title: USA: Ionic Fuel raises $1.7 mln in offering.
newsitem.headline: Ionic Fuel raises $1.7 mln in offering.

text.p: Ionic Fuel Technology Inc said Monday that it has completed a private offering of Common Stock and Class C Warrants for $2.25 per unit, raising $1.7 million.
The capital will provide entry into new markets, said the company.

Each of the 771,833 units sold consist of one share of common stock at $2.25 and one warrant, expiring July 10, 2000, to purchase one share of common stock at $2.95. The buyers included three new institutional groups as well as existing shareholders, said Ionic Fuel.
In separate news, the company said it is currently in talks with large multinationals concerning joint ventures and licensing arrangements which should be completed during the summer.
Ionic Fuels is an environmental and combustion technology company.
